channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Harmanpreet Kaur Becomes Most-Capped Women’s Cricketer With Historic 356th International Appearance
item.description: India captain Harmanpreet Kaur surpasses Suzie Bates with 356 international matches, marking a defining moment in women’s cricket history.

item.title: After Nearly 2-Month Freeze, Bangladesh’s PM Tarique Rahman Restores Visa Services For Indians, Signals Diplomatic Reset
item.description: Bangladesh resumes full visa services for Indians, signalling a diplomatic reset and renewed people-to-people engagement after weeks of strained bilateral ties.

item.title: Gurugram Horror: Neighbour Allegedly Lures 3-Year-Old 4km, Rapes, Strangles & Buries Her in Pit; Investigation Underway
item.description: A 24-year-old neighbour lured a 3-year-old girl 4km from her Gurugram village home, raped and strangled her before burying the body in a pit, leading to his swift arrest after confession.

item.title: Global AI Summit Disrupted: 4 Youth Congress Leaders Arrested After Shirtless Protest at Bharat Mandapam
item.description: Youth Congress members detained after shirtless protest at India AI Summit sparks political row.

item.title: From Coding at 3 to Keynote at 8: Ranvir Sachdeva Captivates Global Leaders at India AI Impact Summit 2026
item.description: Eight-year-old technologist Ranvir Sachdeva addressed global CEOs and policymakers, blending Indian philosophy with modern AI innovation.

item.title: Tripura’s 15-Year-Old Chess Prodigy Arshiya Das Gets Northeast India’s First WIM Title
item.description: After winning the 42nd Rudar IM Round Robin tournament in Serbia with 6.5/9, Arshiya Das completed her final WIM norm, marking a historic breakthrough for Tripura and the entire Northeast region.

item.title: Maharashtra: 37-Year-Old Man Allegedly Kills 65-Year-Old Mother Over Bitter Gourd Curry Dispute
item.description: A minor argument over dinner reportedly escalated into fatal violence, raising concerns about alcohol abuse and domestic conflict in rural Maharashtra.

item.title: Driverless Car in Motion? Bhopal Youth Climbs Onto Roof for Stunt, Arrested After Video Goes Viral
item.description: A youth from Bhopal was arrested and charged with rash driving after a viral video captured him performing a dangerous stunt on the roof of a moving car with no one in the driver's seat.

item.title: Five Family Members Found Dead Inside Locked House In Kasganj, Uttar Pradesh; Probe Underway
item.description: Police broke open a locked home in Amanpur, Kasganj, where five family members were found dead, with the cause under investigation.

item.title: Donald Trump Raises Global Tariffs From 10% To 15% After Court Setback, Escalating Trade Tensions Worldwide
item.description: President Donald Trump increased global tariffs by 5% a day after a major court ruling challenged his trade authority, prompting mixed reactions across markets and governments.
